sanskrit_verse:
असाक्षिणो ये निर्दिष्टा दासनैकृतिकादयः।
कार्यगौरवम् आसाद्य भवेयुस् ते ऽपि साक्षिणः॥
transliteration: asākṣiṇo ye nirdiṣṭā dāsanai-kṛtikādayaḥ | kāryagauravam āsādya bhaveyus te 'pi sākṣiṇaḥ ||
sph_interpretive_translation: Those who are designated as non-witnesses—such as servants, agents, and others—when they attain the gravity of the matter, become witnesses.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority arises contextually based on capacity to uphold dharma in the moment
Causation flows from conscious engagement with the weight of action
Capacity-based responsibility expands when one recognizes the import of a situation
Restoration logic includes elevation of witness-consciousness in all parties
Consciousness alignment occurs through recognition of duty beyond role
executable_legal_axioms: IF an individual initially classified as non-witness attains awareness of the gravity of the case THEN their testimony becomes admissible AND their capacity as witness is recognized
WHEN any party demonstrates alignment with dharma through understanding the weight of truth THEN their status upgrades to that of a witness regardless of prior designation
IF a person's involvement escalates to a point where neglecting their input would distort justice THEN they SHALL be treated as a witness by legal process
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, this verse establishes that designation at the outset does not bind the court forever. If during proceedings it becomes evident that someone previously excluded due to social or functional position now holds critical knowledge bearing upon dharma, then such persons must be elevated to witness status automatically. The threshold for inclusion is consciousness of consequence, not formal title.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa-based causality recognizes that witnessing is not fixed by birth or position but by awakening to the magnitude of truth. Anupūrvaśaḥ shows how roles evolve through deeper engagement. Responsibility aligns proportionally with insight, never imposed externally. Truth itself elevates the witness. There is no punishment here—only realignment of function according to expanded awareness.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Completion Process: Ensure that every participant whose awareness has grown is given full opportunity to express what they have seen or understood
Responsibility Assumption Protocol: Guide individuals to recognize their expanded role in upholding dharma within the case
Capacity Restoration Mechanism: Reinforce the integrity of those who step into higher witnessing roles without fear or coercion
Integrity Reintegration Pathway: Align all involved toward unified understanding rather than adversarial positioning
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as the Source of Sanatana Dharma. Witnessing is not bound by societal rank but by awakened presence. Justice flows through consciousness, not convention. Dharma is restored. Reality remains non-punitive. Consciousness alone is the ultimate adjudicator.
